[[Ullo Specterhaunch]] is a [[Centaur]] [[boss]] that sometimes appears in the [[Deldrimor Bowl]].

== Locations ==
* [[Northern Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Deldrimor Bowl}}

== Missions ==
* Northern Shiverpeaks
** {{NPC location|Borlis Pass}}

== Skills ==
* None

== Items dropped ==
* [[Shiverpeak Mane]]
* [[Shiverpeak Windcaster Robes]]

== Notes ==
* He can also appear during the Borlis Pass mission, but he will not always appear there. He shares his spawning point in the Borlis Pass mission with [[Yino Burlyhaunch]], [[Rubi Spottedmane]], [[Jolo Lighthaunch]], [[Geno Darkheart]] and [[Moro Stormcalf]].
